(() => {
  const node=document.createElement('div');
  node.style.cssText='font:16px/20px serif';
  document.body.append(node);
  const rejected=(html,detail)=>{
    node.innerHTML=html;
    try { node.getBoundingClientRect(); return false; }
    catch(error) { return error.message.includes(detail); }
  };
  const result={};
  result.whitespace=rejected('alpha <span style="white-space:pre">beta</span>','mixed inline text flow');
  result.direction=rejected('alpha <span style="direction:rtl">beta</span>','inline text property (direction)');
  result.transform=rejected('alpha <span style="text-transform:uppercase">beta</span>','mixed inline text flow');
  node.style.textTransform='uppercase';
  result.transformedMetrics=rejected('alpha <span style="font-size:20px">beta</span>','transformed inline metrics');
  node.style.textTransform='none';
  result.borders=rejected('alpha <span style="border-left-style:solid">beta</span>','inline text borders');
  result.vertical=rejected('alpha <span style="font-size:20px;vertical-align:middle">beta</span>','inline text property (vertical-align)');
  result.source=rejected('<span style="font-size:20px">'+'x'.repeat(65537)+'</span>','layout text source');
  result.budget=rejected(Array.from({length:500},(_,i)=>'<span style="font-size:'+(10+i/10)+'px">A</span>').join(''),'layout text shaping');
  node.innerHTML='alpha <span style="font-size:32px;line-height:40px">beta</span>';
  result.recovery=node.getBoundingClientRect().height===40;
  node.innerHTML='alpha <span style="font-size:32px;line-height:10px">beta</span>';
  result.rounding=node.getBoundingClientRect().height===21;
  node.remove();
  return result;
})()
